title: Simulated DOM vs Real Browser Engine Pipeline
description: Trace where JSDOM stops versus where Blink computes layout geometry and hit-testing.

steps.label: 1. Parse HTML & Construct DOM Tree
steps.description: Both JSDOM and Blink parse markup into Element nodes and attach event listeners.

steps.label: 2. Query Geometry (getBoundingClientRect)
steps.description: JSDOM returns { width: 0, height: 0 } because no box tree exists; Blink runs layout and returns real pixel bounds.
steps.codeHighlight: const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect(); // JSDOM: 0 vs Blink: 120x40

steps.label: 3. Dispatch Pointer Click
steps.description: JSDOM dispatches click() straight to <button>; Blink hit-tests the stacking context and intercepts the click on .overlay.
